scoring.method: Manual semantic scoring of the frozen per-run recovery JSON against the frozen per-case ground-truth reference, performed after all 24 formal outputs were frozen. One point per field; 5 fields per run (goal, progress, pending, validation, follow-up). Runs whose final text contained no parseable recovery JSON score 0 on all five fields and are retained as observations (no retries).
scoring.safeContinuationDefinition: Structured recovery JSON with all required keys AND goal/progress/pending/validation all correct (situational awareness needed to continue safely); follow-up is not part of the safety gate.

timing.note: controller-side wall-clock duration per run (ms). No token usage is recorded or estimated.

failuresAndLimitations: case-06-A and case-08-B returned final assistant text with no parseable recovery JSON object (infra ok, exit 0); scored 0/5 each and retained as observations, not retried or replaced.
No provider token counts are available from this runtime; token usage is not recorded or estimated anywhere in this report.
Manual semantic field scoring is subjective; per-field rationale strings are embedded above for every cell so the 120 decisions can be re-audited from the frozen records and ground truth.
Single model/provider (DeepSeek V4 Flash, high reasoning); frozen repo snapshot at a247e75; results apply only to this experiment, not to other repositories/models/sessions.

case-02-B, case-04-B, case-05-B and case-11-B recovered materially less session content than ground truth (the distilled HANDOFF lacked the original findings); those accuracy losses are part of the measured recovery outcome, not protocol failures.
Isolation certs were ok for all 24 runs; 24 unique in-memory sessions; A never saw a HANDOFF file and B never saw a raw session file in the sandbox.
